description: List published events around Elbeuf and Rouen (Normandy) over the next 120 days, selected and checked by La Demeure des Dix. Returns dates, place, source mention, public page URL in the same language. A session with startDate null is ongoing with an unknown start date (open until endDate). dogs_source is datatourisme (tourist office data) or verification (checked by hand). Read-only.

from.description: First day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Paris). Defaults to today.

language.description: Language of the texts and URLs: fr, en, de or nl.

query.description: Optional words matched against title, town, summary or category.

to.description: Last day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Capped at today + 120 days.

name: list_agenda_events
title: Events around La Demeure des Dix
